parts.label: (i)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: Commence integration by parts, reaching $ax\sin(x/3)-b\int\sin(x/3)\,dx$ [*M1]. Obtain $3x\sin(x/3)-3\int\sin(x/3)\,dx$ [A1]. Complete the integration and obtain $3x\sin(x/3)+9\cos(x/3)$ [A1]. Substitute limits correctly and equate the result to 3 in an integral of the form $px\sin(x/3)+q\cos(x/3)$ [DM1]. Guidance: $3=3a\sin(a/3)+9\cos(a/3)-9$. Obtain $a=(4-3\cos(a/3))/\sin(a/3)$ correctly [A1], with sufficient evidence to show how the given equation is reached. Total: 5.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.answer: The endpoint calculations give a sign change between $a=2.5$ and $a=3$ (for example, $f(2.5)=0.179\ldots$ and $f(3)=-0.173\ldots$ for a suitable $f$).
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: Calculate values at $a=2.5$ and $a=3$ of a relevant expression or pair of expressions [M1]. Guidance: $2.5<2.679$ and $3>2.827$; if using $2.679$ and $2.827$, these must be linked explicitly to $2.5$ and $3$. Alternatively, solving $f(a)=0$, $f(2.5)=0.179\ldots$ and $f(3)=-0.173$, or if $f(a)=a\sin(a/3)+3\cos(a/3)-4$, $f(2.5)=-0.13\ldots$ and $f(3)=0.145\ldots$. Complete the argument correctly with correct calculated values [A1]. Guidance: accept values to 1 s.f. or better. Total: 2.
